items.raw_excerpt: With the vote tied, Clarence Valley Council turned to drawing a name out of a hat to decide who should be mayor, only to disagree on who the winner was.
items.summary_en: Clarence Valley Council had a tied vote for mayor. Council members decided to draw a name out of a hat to choose the winner. Then they could not agree on who actually won.
items.summary_ko: 클래런스 밸리 시의회는 투표가 동률이 되자 추첨으로 시장을 뽑기로 했습니다. 하지만 추첨 결과 누가 당선됐는지를 두고 의원들 사이에 이견이 생겼습니다.
items.title_en: Mayor chosen by drawing a name from a hat, then confusion over the winner
items.title_ko: 모자를 뒤집어 뽑은 시장 선출, 승자가 누군지 혼란
items.title_original: Hat-draw to decide mayoral contest ends in confusion

items.raw_excerpt: Three new unions have thrown their weight behind a looming strike at King, the games company behind Candy Crush Saga, which is aimed at ending the company's long refusal to sign a collective bargaining agreement.
items.summary_en: Three new unions now support a coming strike at King, the company behind Candy Crush Saga. The workers want the company to sign a collective bargaining agreement. King has refused to sign one for a long time.
items.summary_ko: 캔디크러시 사가의 개발사 킹에서 곧 열릴 파업에 새 노조 세 곳이 힘을 보탰다. 노동자들은 회사가 단체교섭 합의서에 서명해 달라고 요구하고 있다. 킹은 오랫동안 이 합의서 서명을 거부해 왔다.
items.title_en: More unions join pending strike at Swedish Candy Crush maker
items.title_ko: 캔디크러시 제작사 스웨덴 파업에 노조 추가 합류
items.title_original: More unions join pending strike at Swedish Candy Crush maker

items.raw_excerpt: The tourism, hospitality and agriculture sectors in regional Queensland say changes to Australia's migration system, including introducing a ballot system for working holiday makers, will have devastating impacts.
items.summary_en: Tourism, hospitality and farmers in regional Queensland say Australia's new working holiday visa rules will badly hurt them. The changes include a ballot system for working holiday makers. Business groups say the impact will be devastating.
items.summary_ko: 퀸즈랜드 지역의 관광·요식·농업 업계는 호주 정부의 새로운 워킹홀리데이 비자 규정이 큰 타격을 줄 것이라고 우려하고 있다. 이번 개편에는 워킹홀리데이 메이커 대상 추첨제 도입이 포함됐다. 업계 단체는 그 여파가 참담할 것이라고 말했다.
items.title_en: Regional businesses say new visa rules will hurt them
items.title_ko: 호주 지역 businesses, 새 비자 규정이 타격 줄 것이라 우려
items.title_original: Regional businesses alarmed as Australia limits working holiday visas

items.raw_excerpt: The Primary Health Organisation will install an independent manager at the Pahiatua Medical Centre, where staff are threatening to resign en masse next week, due to under-resourcing.
items.summary_en: The Primary Health Organisation will put an independent manager at the Pahiatua Medical Centre. Staff there are threatening to resign en masse next week because the clinic lacks resources.
items.summary_ko: 1차 보건기구가 파히아투아 의료센터에 독립 관리자를 파견한다. 인력 부족 탓에 이 센터 직원들은 다음 주 일괄 사직을 예고한 상태다.
items.title_original: Primary Health Organisation makes changes at Pahiatua Medical Centre

items.raw_excerpt: Two divine umbrellas from Chennai reached Tiruchanur for Sri Padmavati temple and nine for Tirumala temple's Garuda Seva in the ongoing Brahmotsavams.
items.summary_en: Two sacred umbrellas from Chennai arrived at Tiruchanur for Sri Padmavati temple. Nine more umbrellas reached Tirumala temple for the Garuda Seva event. They are part of the ongoing Brahmotsavams festival.
items.summary_ko: 첸나이에서 출발한 신성한 우산 두 개가 스리 파드마바티 사원의 티루차누르에 도착했습니다. 아홉 개의 우산은 티루말라 사원의 가루다 세바 행사에 도착했으며, 이는 진행 중인 브라모츠바밤 축제의 일부입니다.
items.title_en: Divine umbrellas reach Tirumala for temple festival
items.title_ko: 신성한 우산들, 티루말라 사찰 축제에 도착
items.title_original: Under tight security, ‘divine umbrellas’ from Chennai reach Tirupati for Tirumala Brahmotsavams

items.raw_excerpt: Thinking about your first Oktoberfest? Readers say it's all about planning ahead, pacing yourself and looking after your friends. Unfortunately, The Local's Tom Pugh had to learn those lessons the hard way.
items.summary_en: A writer shares advice for people going to Oktoberfest for the first time. He says to plan ahead, pace yourself, and look after your friends. He learned these lessons the hard way at the festival.
items.summary_ko: 작가가 처음 옥토버페스트를 찾는 사람들을 위해 조언을 전한다. 미리 계획하고 속도를 조절하며 친구를 잘 챙기라고 말한다. 그는 이 교훈을 페스트에서 뼈저리게 배웠다.
items.title_en: What I wish I knew before my disastrous Oktoberfest
items.title_ko: 엉망이 된 옥토버페스트에 가기 전 알았더라면 좋았을 조언
items.title_original: The key advice I wish I’d known before my disastrous Oktoberfest

items.raw_excerpt: Spain is long-established as one of the world's major orange producers, but a combination of factors mean that 'naranjas' from South Africa, Morocco and Egypt increasingly line Spanish supermarket shelves.
items.summary_en: Spain has long been a major orange producer in the world. But many factors now put oranges from South Africa, Morocco, and Egypt on Spanish supermarket shelves.
items.summary_ko: 스페인은 오랫동안 세계 주요 오렌지 생산국이었습니다. 하지만 여러 요인 때문에 남아프리카, 모로코, 이집트산 오렌지가 스페인 마트 선반에 점점 더 많이 놓이고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Why does citrus-producing Spain import so many oranges?
items.title_ko: 오렌지 주산국 스페인, 왜 이토록 많은 오렌지를 수입할까?
items.title_original: Why does citrus-producing Spain import so many oranges?

items.raw_excerpt: Many people in Denmark spend their holidays living in summer houses, but what are the rules for staying at the properties all year round?
items.summary_en: Many Danes spend holidays in summer houses. But there are rules about staying in them all year round. Learn what the rules are and when you can live in one.
items.summary_ko: 많은 덴마크 사람들이 휴가를 여름 별장에서 보냅니다. 하지만 별장을 일 년 내내 쓰는 데는 규칙이 있습니다. 어떤 규칙인지, 언제 살 수 있는지 자세히 알아봅니다.
items.title_en: Danish summer house rules: Can you live in one all year?
items.title_ko: 덴마크 여름 별장 사기: 어떤 규칙이 있고 언제 살 수 있을까
items.title_original: Buying a Danish summer house: What are the rules and when can you live in them?

items.raw_excerpt: Only one domestic flight is currently in operation in Switzerland – the one connecting international hubs of Zurich and Geneva, which is operated by SWISS only. But some legislators want to open more routes to foreign carriers as well.
items.summary_en: Today only SWISS flies between Zurich and Geneva. Some lawmakers want to open domestic routes to foreign airlines too, such as a line from Geneva to Lugano.
items.summary_ko: 지금까지 스위스 국내선은 취리히와 제네바를 잇는 SWISS 노선 하나뿐이다. 일부 의원들은 제네바~루가노 같은 국내선을 외국 항공사에도 개방하자고 주장하고 있다.
items.title_en: Switzerland May Let Foreign Airlines Fly Domestic Routes
items.title_ko: 스위스, 국내선 노선에 외국 항공사 진출 허용 검토
items.title_original: Geneva to Lugano? Switzerland could allow foreign airlines to run domestic routes

items.raw_excerpt: North Melbourne has lost for the first time in almost three years, with the two-time defending AFLW premier falling to a shock 7-point defeat to Hawthorn in Cairns.
items.summary_en: North Melbourne lost for the first time in almost three years. The two-time defending AFLW champion fell to Hawthorn by 7 points in Cairns. The loss ends their 32-game winning streak.
items.summary_ko: 노스멜버른이 거의 3년 만에 처음으로 패배했습니다. 2회 연속 우승을 차지한 AFLW 챔피언 노스멜버른이 케언스에서 호손에 7점 차로 충격적인 패배를 당했습니다. 이번 패배로 32연승 행진이 끝났습니다.
items.title_en: North Melbourne's 32-game winning streak ends after shock loss to Hawthorn
items.title_original: North Melbourne's 32-game winning streak over after shock loss to Hawthorn
